model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the performance or behavior of several LLM variants—StrmLLM and multiple configurations of SepLLM—across a range of input or iteration steps, likely measuring a metric such as loss, perplexity, or accuracy over time. The x-axis, labeled “Iterations” or a similar term (partially obscured), spans from 0 to approximately 1000 with a linear scale and major gridlines at intervals of 200. The y-axis, labeled “Performance” or “Loss” (also partially obscured), ranges from 0 to 1.0 with a linear scale and major tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Five distinct lines are plotted: a blue solid line for StrmLLM (n=64), which starts near 1.0 and declines steadily to ~0.3; an orange solid line for SepLLM (n=64), starting near 1.0 and ending around 0.4; a green solid line for SepLLM (n=64, H), beginning near 1.0 and stabilizing near 0.45; a red solid line for SepLLM (n=64, H/T), starting near 1.0 and ending near 0.5; and a purple solid line for SepLLM (n=128), which begins near 1.0 and ends slightly above 0.5. All lines exhibit a sharp initial drop followed by a slower, more gradual decline, with StrmLLM (n=64) consistently outperforming the others across the range.
